name: Skarmory + Gastrodon
why: Gastrodon takes Skarmory's Electric and Fire hits; Skarmory resists Gastrodon's 4× Grass.

name: Slowking + Skarmory + Excadrill
why: Slowking and Skarmory cover each other's weaknesses; Excadrill is immune to Electric.

name: Garchomp + Alakazam + Ferrothorn
why: Layered hazards wear down Steel types, and Rough Skin and Iron Barbs punish U-turn.

name: Tyranitar + Keldeo + Scizor
why: Tyranitar removes Keldeo's counters; Scizor resists Keldeo's Grass, Flying, Psychic holes.

name: Magnezone + Latios + Kyurem-Black
why: Magnezone traps the Steels that wall Latios and Kyurem-Black; Latios floats over Ground.

name: Scizor + Rotom-Wash
why: Rotom-Wash resists Fire, Scizor's 4× weakness; Scizor resists Rotom's Grass weakness.

name: Landorus-Therian + Jirachi
why: Jirachi resists Landorus's 4× Ice weakness; Landorus ignores Jirachi's Ground weakness.

name: Tornadus + Mamoswine + Ferrothorn
why: Mamoswine breaks Zapdos so Tornadus can sweep; Ferrothorn covers their Fighting hole.

name: Scizor + Tentacruel
why: Tentacruel handles Volcarona and spins; Scizor handles Psychic types and resists Grass.

name: Rotom-Wash + Mamoswine
why: Mamoswine's Ice and Ground moves beat the Grass types that threaten Rotom-Wash.

name: Hydreigon + Starmie
why: Starmie resists Hydreigon's Fighting and Ice; Hydreigon resists Starmie's Dark, Ghost.

name: Volcarona + Keldeo
why: Volcarona hits Keldeo's Grass checks; Keldeo hits the Rock types that wall Volcarona.

name: Latios + Heatran
why: Heatran resists Latios's weaknesses; Latios floats over Ground and resists Water.

name: Heatran + Venusaur
why: Heatran resists Venusaur's weaknesses; Venusaur resists Heatran's Water, Ground, Fighting.

name: Jellicent + Ferrothorn
why: Ferrothorn resists all four of Jellicent's weaknesses; Jellicent resists Fire, Fighting.
